risk_areas.evidence: LOCAL phone/password flow normalizes identifiers, hashes passwords, emits generic login failures, and excludes credentials from responses.
Portal access is permission-driven; protected Account/UserProfile routes require ADMIN portal and granular permissions.
DTO whitelist rejects portal, role, permission, accountId, and audit metadata.
Account, AuthIdentity, UserProfile, and AccountRole provisioning is one UnitOfWork transaction with real rollback evidence.
Named PostgreSQL provider/identifier unique violation is translated to phone_already_exists/409; concurrent real-database E2E evidence asserts one 201 and one 409.
Refresh rotation is single-use; logout, lock, delete, password, and phone security transitions revoke or invalidate sessions/tokens.
Refresh token remains HttpOnly and refresh requests enforce the configured Origin allowlist.
HTTP and system actors populate audit metadata through isolated RequestContext state.
Identity/profile migrations contain required foreign keys, uniqueness, indexes, audit fields, and reversible down paths; current validation reports run/revert/run success.
Backend-only API scope and registration request, success, and reachable error responses are documented and contract-tested.
Authorization and cookies are redacted in validation logs; password hashes are not present in response DTOs.
Cycle-001 addendum explicitly removes frontend from MEMORIES-0002.
